newsitem.title: UK: Turk children at risk of torture says rights group.
newsitem.headline: Turk children at risk of torture says rights group.

text.p: Children are increasingly becoming victims of torture in Turkey because the government has failed to enforce safeguards, human rights group Amnesty International said on Wednesday.

The London-based group claimed in a report that children as young as 12, in some cases detained on suspicion of minor offences, "had been subjected to appalling cruelty in police custody," including beatings and electric shocks.
The 31-page report documented cases of children who had died or disappeared in police custody over the past four years.
Amnesty also said the Kurdish Workers' Party (PKK) had been responsible for the death of Turkish children.
The PKK, a separatist guerrilla group that has been involved in a 12-year armed conflict with the Turkish government, has killed children during village massacres, Amnesty said.
